description: A disconnected computer cable. A glowing black screen. A simple red message: 'Move the large potted plant next to the ground floor elevator at 8:17 AM.'

For twelve years, Jack obeyed every bizarre favor from the entity called the Seer—shifting furniture, picking lottery numbers, parking in specific stalls. In return, he received boundless wealth, executive promotions, and the love of his life. But every miracle had an unseen victim, and on a stormy November night, the horrifying geometric tapestry of fate finally converged upon his own doorstep.
A Scroll Kaos 3D horror story, told in the first person. Watch until the very end.
